## Water-energy resource scheduling

::: {.entry-card}
The [SPTO study](https://doi.org/10.1109/TSG.2025.3601238) models the full urban water-supply process under uncertain electricity prices. Probabilistic price forecasts parameterize a stochastic scheduling problem, and a convex upper bound on the optimality gap provides gradients for training. Experiments on real-world systems compare operating cost and decision regret with two-stage baselines.

[Read the case study](industrial-workflow-analysis.qmd)
:::

## Urban water forecasting and pressure modeling

::: {.entry-card}
Two first-authored studies address different sources of forecast error. [KbBcM](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.eswa.2024.124508) targets delayed responses near changes in daily demand. [CritiCoder](https://doi.org/10.1109/TCSS.2023.3272330) represents pressure variation associated with unobserved disturbances.

[Read the case study](service-operations-planning.qmd)
:::

## Learned decision rules

::: {.two-col-grid}
::: {.feature-card}
### Candidate action selection

[GEM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.23232) retains multiple action hypotheses with a Gaussian-mixture actor. Its inference rule ranks candidates by conservative value and behavior-model support.
:::
::: {.feature-card}
### Local trajectory generation

[DRIFT](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.eswa.2026.133261) stores local LiDAR geometry as graph memory and retrieves waypoint-specific context during recurrent denoising.
:::
:::
